summary: Returns the pointer stored at index a1 of the global pointer table off_5BE6C4, cast to int. Indexing is unguarded: any a1 value is accepted and the element is dereferenced directly. operations.description: Pointer arithmetic: element address = &off_5BE6C4[a1], i.e. off_5BE6C4 + a1 * element_stride. The off_* symbol type implies 4-byte pointer elements (DERIVED stride, not present verbatim in the packet).
Dereference the indexed element and return it as int.
No bounds guard precedes the dereference; out-of-range a1 yields an out-of-bounds read, so the caller is responsible for a valid index.
